pages.text: The Combatant's Companion is a combat guide book covering the advanced combat systems active in this pack — likely from Epic Fight or Better Combat. It documents attack combos, dodge mechanics, weapon stances, and skill interactions.$(br2)$(bold)Key systems covered:$() Directional attacks, stamina management, weapon type advantages, and how class abilities interact with the combat system.$(br2)If lost, check JEI for the crafting recipe — the book is craftable and not a one-time reward.
